steps: Opened clean h17-clean.txt; CLI wrote H17 CLI first newline; App showed it without dirty/conflict.
Switched to sample.ts and clicked actual Terminal input (owned test task already stopped, 0 running). Independent readback remained first version.
CLI wrote H17 CLI second newline; returned to file and explicitly refreshed via file menu. Actual editor showed second version and remained clean; terminal still 0 running.
A.actual: Both revisions remained on disk and appeared in order; no CLI-specific approve/tracking/restore controls or implied task completion. Independent readback confirms no rollback.
A.boundary: No App save-call instrumentation in A; production save/checkpoint/native-write absence verified by complete I matrix. A terminal focus is actual native AX click, not PTY lifecycle proof.

boundaries: No actual App automation by this subagent; DOM events run in jsdom. Root supplies A-layer focus/terminal/read-error visibility.
Ordinary external writer is a direct independent filesystem writer; CLI writer is a separate Electron-as-Node process. No actual third-party GUI writer in I; root tests TextEdit in A.

Rich Markdown is the real production parser/Worker/widgets. Only Worker communication is adapted to node:worker_threads; code syntax worker is isolated because fixtures have headings/emphasis, no code fences.
File panel hide/remount in I is component/store lifecycle. No real PTY here and no inference that disk change means a CLI task finished. Root supplies actual terminal switch/PID evidence.
Native broker comes from r5; TypeScript sources match frozen r6 snapshot. This does not claim r5 App contains DEV047 or later product changes.
No source-file save calls or checkpoint calls in clean scenarios. Conflict scenario may schedule recovery checkpoint but no source-file save.

case.expected: With no manual dirty, two consecutive CLI writes are read in order while switching files/panel/terminal and refreshing; no special CLI approval/tracking or automatic disk restore; disk writes do not imply CLI command completion.
case.rows: Three CLI-process rows of shared 8-case report, each with two sequential revisions and native watch/reactivation/explicit-refresh coverage.
case.eachSuccess: First latest bytes shown rich/source; between writes file panel hides/remounts and explicitly refreshes, reactivation row switches other file before each write; second latest bytes shown rich/source. App save/checkpoint/native source-save count zero, source disk exactly equals each independent writer snapshot.
case.uiBoundary: No approval/tracking/action assertions fabricated from minimal EditorView host. Actual App controls/terminal focus and lack of CLI-specific tracking are root A evidence.
